_comment: Copy to e2e.local.json (gitignored). Minimal N=1 only needs source_group_id, target_group_id, single_qq, interval_ms, allow_real_invite=true. odd_tail_qqs / protocol_7_qqs / stop_gate_qqs are optional later scenarios and must be disjoint from any configured set.
